text:
kelly_support: Heads up — customer report: free trial credits not applied after signup. They verified email and added a payment method but account shows credits = 0. Ticket #9876. :wave:

samir_billing: Can you drop the account id / masked email and any payment intent id? I'll check gating rules. :eyes:

kelly_support: Sure — acct snippet (masked):
```json
{"account_id":"acct_8a3f4c","email":"user+prod@company.com","region":"eu-west-1","email_verified":true,"trial_credits":0,"pm_last4":"4242","pm_status":"requires_action"}
```
Payment intent id: pi_1JZabcXYZ_reqa

samir_billing: thanks. `pm_status: requires_action` usually means 3DS/SCA wasn't completed. For EU signups our flow currently needs either no PM or a PM in `succeeded` to auto-grant due to fraud rules. i'll pull the payment intent now.

maria_engineer: @samir_billing i'll check the signup logs for the grant path — forwarding you the internal trace id in a sec.

samir_billing: pulled the PI: `requires_action` -> customer never finished 3DS. Our grant job skipped acct_8a3f4c at T+0 because of the gate: `trial_auto_grant_payment_gate_v2`. That explains why credits stayed 0.

josh_support: can we do a manual grant here so the customer isn't stuck? we should include a note to customer about finishing 3DS if they want to keep using billing features.

samir_billing: i will do manual grant. running internal patch: 
```bash
PATCH /internal/accounts/acct_8a3f4c/grant?amount=100 --data '{"reason":"manual_support_grant","ticket":9876}'
```
TX id: tx_9923_manual_grant

josh_support: done on our side — customer confirmed they now see 100 trial credits. They also completed 3DS after we reached out. Closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:

kelly_support: Great — closing ticket and noting root cause: payment method in `requires_action` blocked auto-grant in EU. Follow-ups: 1) update signup UI copy to warn EU users that adding a card may delay credits until 3DS completes, 2) add telemetry metric `trial_grant_blocked_by_payment_status`, 3) ops doc entry for manual grants.

maria_engineer: i'll add a small telemetry flag and open a PR for the copy change (estimate: 1 day). Filing infra task to add metric and a boolean on the grant event.

samir_billing: +1 to OPS doc. Also proposing we consider relaxing the gate for low-risk profiles (low volume, email verified, matching ip/geo) — will draft a risk rubric.

josh_support: nice. tagging this for the monthly support/billing sync so product can weigh in. :ship:
